question: Make level 85 feel tougher than 75 and level 100 like a proper finale, with surviving wins at each unlock level.
evidenceTier: Controlled production-engine simulations; not human playtest win rates.
scope: Three level-85 signature powers and four finale HP/stat budgets only. No global engine, AP, cooldown, costs, resource, identity, kit, reward, or progression changes.

acceptance.home: All eight reference builds defeat each village boss at its own unlock level with positive HP before round25. Level85 has lower median low-point HP, more actual HP loss, more healing actions and longer sustained pressure than75; finales inflict more actual HP loss, with lower low-point HP and median ending HP <=25%.
acceptance.field: All 480 fixed-policy cases are recorded. Each village/biome requires at least7/8 healthy clears and a healthy clear in every school. A specific allocation in unfavorable terrain may lose. This deliberately replaces the previous all-builds/all-biomes win requirement while retaining all-build wins for normal village starts.

fixture: Same acquired Earth/Wind twelve-slot rare-shop builds as the previous late-story pass. Mastery30 at75/85;40 at100 with eight damaging techniques. Earned-point conservation and rank caps; no bloodline, pet, relic, consumable or mid-fight reset.
policy: Unchanged visible-state reference policy: heal below55%, use weapon/utility, Clear active setups and Cleanse harmful effects. No future-response search. Experimental alternative priorities/healing thresholds were not used for the final acceptance matrices.
